arStrings.szText: Rain of Arrows

{c_important}Rain of Arrows{/c} no longer Immobilizes, and instead, its first wave Knocks Down enemies for {c_number}{buffduration:MOD_KNOCKDOWN}{/c} seconds.

Casting {c_important}Rain of Arrows{/c} consumes {c_number}[SF_40]{/c} stacks of {c_important}{u}Overpower{/u}{/c} to send out {c_number}[SF_41]{/c} additional waves, each dealing {c_number}{payload:UPGRADE_A_TOOLTIP_DAMAGE}{/c} damage.
Monsoon

{c_important}Rain of Arrows{/c} now comes in from the sides in shorter waves and no longer Immobilizes, but instead deals {c_number}{payload:UPGRADE_B_TOOLTIP_DAMAGE}{/c} damage, Knocks Back enemies towards the center, and makes them {c_important}{u}Vulnerable{/u}{/c} for {c_number}{SF_34}{/c} seconds.
Crashing Waves
{c_important}Rain of Arrows{/c} also unleashes {c_number}[SF_30]{/c} {c_important}Arrow Storms{/c} that target Nearby enemies, each dealing {c_number}{payload:UPGRADE_C_TOOLTIP_DAMAGE}{/c} damage.
Flash Flood
{c_important}Rain of Arrows'{/c} Cooldown is reduced by {c_number}{SF_35}{/c} seconds.
Cooldown
{c_important}Rain of Arrows{/c} deals {c_number}[{SF_36} * 100|%x|]{/c} increased damage and has a {c_number}[{SF_39} * 100|%|]{/c} chance to deal double damage.
Double Damage
{c_important}Rain of Arrows'{/c} damage is increased by {c_number}[{SF_37}*100|%x|]{/c} for every stack of {c_important}{u}Ferocity{/u}{/c} you have when Casting {c_important}Rain of Arrows{/c}.
Ferocity
{c_important}Rain of Arrows'{/c} Cast Speed is increased by {c_number}[{SF_38} * 100|%+|]{/c} and Lucky Hit Chance is increased by {c_number}[{SF_44} * 100|%x|]{/c}.
Cast Speed and Lucky Hit
{c_important}Rain of Arrows{/c} deals {c_number}[SF_23*100|%x|]{/c} increased damage to both {c_important}{u}Vulnerable{/u}{/c} and Crowd Controlled enemies.
Supreme Rain of Arrows
{c_important}Imbuement{/c} Skill effects applied by {c_important}Rain of Arrows{/c} have {c_number}[{SF_9}*100|%x|]{/c} increased potency.
Prime Rain of Arrows
